name: Yinhe Qi Ri Shengcun Faze
source:
In the year 3114 of the Starcrown Era, artificial womb technology has been legalized within the Galactic Union.

Due to an unexpected malfunction on the Galactic public railway, you are forced to land on Ferron—a planet riddled with black markets and illegal industries.

By day, you are free to explore Ferron: gather clues, build relationships, take part-time jobs, and uncover fragments of truth.

By night, escalating crises emerge, and you must face the dangers hidden beneath the planet’s surface.

Can you survive until the day you finally leave?

And when all the clues are pieced together, the truth of Ferron may be far more unsettling than you imagined…
[From Steam]
